methods.name: invoke
methods.signature: invoke<I = unknown, O = unknown>(alias: string, input: I): Promise<O>
methods.doc: Synchronously invoke a linked function by its spec.bindings.links alias (ADR-0064). funcd checks the input against the target's contract (funcd ADR-0303); its result is returned. Fails closed (rejects) if the caller declares no such link. The target receives `input` as its `event.data`, except that an object with a top-level `data` or `specversion` key is taken as a full CloudEvent envelope (ADR-0134): the target receives only its `data`, and the other keys are dropped. To send an object that has its own `data` key, wrap it in an envelope: `{ specversion: '1.0', data: { data: [1], page: 2 } }`.

methods.name: fetch
methods.signature: fetch(alias: string, path: string, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response>
methods.doc: Send an HTTP request to a linked Function that serves HTTP (spec.protocol: http) by its spec.bindings.links alias (funcd ADR-0243). `path` starts with "/" and may carry a query. The reply comes back whole, at most 1 MiB, with its status and headers; funcd answers an error status, and calls nothing, for an undeclared link or a target that does not serve HTTP (call it with invoke).

methods.name: remainingMs

methods.doc: Milliseconds left before the call's deadline (X-Funcd-Timeout-Ms), floored at 0; null without one (ADR-0226).
